source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS (smbus/i2c inventory readout) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "smbus". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES treats generic FRU_SYS.Name/Oem as SMBus inventory, uses curl -k and provides no bus/channel/address identity, schema validation or no-control boundary.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires the vendor-defined SMBus resource, complete device map and strict no-probe/no-write handling.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 964/2291 accepts the generic command without establishing that Oem contains SMBus inventory.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Miramar_Sensor is telemetry and SMC_FPGA is firmware inventory; neither establishes the SMBus device/address map.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved collectors; ED-35 prevents generic-OEM coverage substitution; ED-36 treats vendor map/schema as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify the platform's SMBus inventory information exposed in BMC Hardware status is readable and correct.
original_method: Resolve the approved vendor SMBus/I2C inventory surface, collect complete read-only bus/channel/address/device/presence/status evidence, and compare it to the platform map and WebUI without probing addresses or invoking OEM controls.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the authoritative SMBus resource/schema and device-address map. The agent may parse approved read-only inventory; WebUI/OEM interpretation and final acceptance remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not scan/probe unknown addresses, write registers or invoke OEM control actions.
Do not assume FRU_SYS.Oem is SMBus inventory without schema proof.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Redact credentials, identifiers and write-capable metadata.
Stop on unknown schema, ambiguous address or incomplete inventory without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the supported SMBus inventory resource and schema.
Collect complete redacted read-only records with timestamps.
Normalize bus, channel, address, device type, identity, presence and status.
Compare to vendor map and matching WebUI entries.
Return evidence only and prove no probe/write/control occurred.
engineer_actions: Approve the vendor schema and device topology.
Review mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient: a generic Name/Oem dump neither proves the SMBus resource nor provides complete device/address evidence and may expose OEM controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved read-only vendor inventory API with schema validation and normalize every expected device; never probe the bus or follow control links.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: smbus, WebUI inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform schema-validated, complete read-only SMBus inventory reconciliation under a strict no-probe/no-write boundary.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected platform's BMC-managed SMBus/I2C topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/OEM schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SMBus topology/OEM schema and Project hardware recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an authoritative resource, per-device mapping, protected parsing and bus-safety controls while retaining WebUI verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A populated Oem object or HTTP success is not proof of complete SMBus topology or correctness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor schema, topology and expected device/state matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM objects may expose control surfaces; aggressive bus probing can hang devices or the management controller.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory interfaces require approved bus/device identity, equivalent presence/status coverage, a no-write guarantee and disclosure of uncovered WebUI/OEM fields.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master's SMBus readability/correctness intent is clear; DeepSeek's generic Oem query is an unproven implementation assumption, not an alternate authoritative purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: SMBus inventory purpose is reviewable; resource/schema/topology are Project execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects generic Oem as automatic SMBus proof and adds complete device/address safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-probe/no-write controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds resource/schema validity and bus-safety gates missing from generic direct execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps bus inventory distinct from sensor telemetry and firmware inventory.

review_improvement: Prevents an unrelated OEM blob from passing an SMBus case and makes complete topology plus non-invasive collection explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: SMBus correctness is about an expected topology of buses, mux channels, addresses and devices. A chassis OEM object may be unrelated or incomplete, while active probing can disturb stateful or timing-sensitive components; only a vendor-supported read-only inventory surface can satisfy this view case safely.
